questions.prompt: How does a hypothesis differ from a prediction?
questions.answer: The hypothesis proposes an explanation or relationship; a prediction states expected observations under it and its assumptions.
Defining how an abstract concept will be observed or measured.
A pattern discovered in data is not independently confirmed by those same data.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: States a testable hypothesis, operational measurement, rival explanation and contrary result.
scoring.transfer: Design a paper-only experiment about an everyday work process. Record your prediction, units, comparison and contrary outcome before generating or inspecting simulated results.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
